content: धुर् {%f.%} (<ab>Nom.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> धूः) .²1 A yoke (<ab>lit.</ab>); न गर्दभा वाजिधुरं वहन्ति <ls>Mk. 4. 17</ls>; अत्रस्नुभिर्युक्तधुरं तुरङ्गैः <ls>R. 14. 47</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) That part of a yoke which rests on the shoulder. .³({%b%}) The foremost part of the pole where the yoke is fixed. .²3 The pin at both ends of an axle for fastening the nave of the wheel. .²4 The shaft or pole of a carriage. .²5 A load, burden (<ab>fig.</ab> also); responsibility, duty, task; तेन धूर्जगतो गुर्वी सचिवेषु निचिक्षिपे <ls>R. 1. 34</ls>, <ls n="R.">2. 74</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 35</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 66</ls>; <ls>Ku. 6. 30</ls>; कार्यधुरं वहन्ति <ls>Mu. 1. 14</ls>; आप्तैरप्यनवाप्तपौरुषफलैः कार्यस्य धूरुज्झिता <ls>Mu. 6. 5</ls>, <ls n="Mu.">4. 6</ls>; <ls>Ki. 3. 50</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">14. 6</ls>. .²6 The foremost or highest place, van, front, top, head; अपांसुलानां धुरि कीर्तनीया <ls>R. 2. 2</ls>; धुरि स्थिता त्वं पतिदेवतानाम् <ls n="R.">14. 74</ls>; अविघ्नमस्तु ते स्थेयाः पितेव धुरि पुत्रिणाम् <ls n="R.">1. 91</ls>; धुरि प्रतिष्ठापयितव्य एव <ls>M. 1. 16</ls>, <ls n="M.">5. 16</ls>. .²7 A finger. .²8 Agitation, trembling. .²9 Reflection. .²10 A spark of fire. .²11 Distress, affliction. .²12 A part, portion, share. .²13 Wealth. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of the Ganges. (धुरि कृ ‘to place at the head or in front of’; किंवाभविष्यदरुणस्तमसां विभेत्ता तं चेत्सहस्रकिरणो धुरि नाकरिष्यत् <ls>Ś. 7. 4</ls>)
